answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 167789 Country: Saudi arabia Title: CAN I PAY HOUSE TAX ALONG WITH PENALTY WITH MY BANK INTEREST AMOUNT Question: I have not paid my house tax for 2 years so municipality dept put the huge penalty. So can I pay my house tax along with penalty with my bank interest amount? Answer ID: 167789 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 580/490/B=05/1440) You should pay house tax (the tax that is levied against municipality facilities) with your pure income. However, land tax and penalty money may be paid with interest money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
